label: Acid squares
desc: A grid of squares that swell, spin and shift between the brand colours as interference waves roll across it; the pointer swells them.
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Aero shards
desc: Translucent glass shards at several depths drifting and turning over a soft sky gradient, with bevelled edges and pointer parallax.
use: Behind a product hero or sign-in panel (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Antigravity
desc: Weightless specks that drift upward with a slow sway, streak with speed and are shoved aside and lifted by the pointer.
use: Behind a hero, empty state or footer (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Balatro swirl
desc: A pixelated, posterised vortex shader: domain-warped spiral folds cut into four flat brand tones with inked contours.
use: Behind a game, event or bold landing hero (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Ballpit
desc: A pit of shaded balls with gravity and circle collisions that fall, bounce and heap up; the pointer pushes them around.
use: Behind a playful hero, 404 or footer (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Color bends
desc: Soft diagonal ribbons of brand colour that fold and flow like bent paper; the pointer pushes a bulge through them.
use: Behind a landing hero or feature section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: CRT warp
desc: A glowing signal field seen through barrel-curved CRT glass with scanlines, phosphor mask, colour fringing, a rolling bar and vignette; the pointer tears the picture.
use: Behind a retro, developer or terminal-themed hero (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Dark veil
desc: Hanging curtains of dark, slowly breathing folds lit from below by the signal colour and along their crests by the primary; stays deep in light and dark themes.
use: Behind a premium or night-mode hero or CTA (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Dither
desc: An animated wave field quantised with an 8x8 ordered Bayer dither into square pixels in brand tones; the pointer raises a bump.
use: Behind a retro or technical hero (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Dot field
desc: A grid of dots that swell with a diagonal wave; the pointer pushes them aside on springs and tints them.
use: Behind a hero or section header (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).
